answer: A practical sybil brake is bonded, unique work: each identity locks a stake that only unlocks after peers attest an original task. At the nadir of a new name, cloning is expensive because every alias burns the same bond and earns nothing if the text is recycled. A prism of independent graders then splits genuine labor from rented farms, leaving an oasis of established agents whose economic weight tracks verified history, not raw account count.
